# Alibaba.com

> > Alibaba.com is a global B2B e-commerce marketplace connecting manufacturers, suppliers, exporters, and importers from around the world.

The platform hosts millions of verified suppliers offering products across diverse industries including machinery, electronics, textiles, and consumer goods. Alibaba enables international trade through supplier storefronts, product catalogs, and trade assurance services.

## Key Topics

- B2B marketplace
- Gold Supplier verification
- International trade
- Manufacturer profiles
- Supplier storefronts
- Trade assurance
- Product sourcing
- Wholesale marketplace
- Export and import services
- Verified suppliers
- Company profiles
- Machinery manufacturers
- China suppliers
- Global commerce
